HEADLINE: This is in continuation of our earlier intimation dated 13th November 2026, disseminated on the Stock Exchange portal at 21:58:35 hours, wherein the Company had submitted the outcome of ....
MORE: This is in continuation of our earlier intimation dated 13th November 2026, disseminated on the Stock Exchange portal at 21:58:35 hours, wherein the Company had submitted the outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors held on 13th November 2026 regarding Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. In this regard, we wish to clarify that the outcome of the Board Meeting inadvertently contained certain clerical/typographical errors. Accordingly, we are hereby submitting the revised outcome of the Board Meeting to rectify the aforesaid errors. We wish to clarify that the revision is limited solely to the correction of the aforesaid clerical/typographical errors, and there is no change in the agenda items considered by the Board or in the financial figures and other substantive contents of the outcome originally submitted.
